title: Blessing skill
wikitext:
{{for|other uses of the word "Blessing"|Blessing (disambiguation)}}

A '''Blessing Skill''' is a [[gem tag]] for support skills that modifies the [[aura]]'s [[reservation]] cost into something else. You can only have one aura on you from your Blessing Skills.
